notes.subject: o tla fofa
notes.rationale: תעפה: 'go fofa' (fly) kgahlanong le 'go fetfa' (faint, go swa ke lefsifsi) — KJV/JPS di kgetha go fofa, ASV/BSB go fetfa

notes.subject: bophelo
notes.rationale: חלד ke bophelo bjalo ka nako ye e fofago, gantši 'lefase'; 'bophelo' ke karolo ya bja mo go feta

notes.subject: go Jobo
notes.rationale: Zofara o bolela a lebišitše Jobo, o mo hwetša ka tshepo ya phetolo

translation: Gomme bophelo bja gago bo tla ema go feta sefelle se segolo; o tla fofa, o tla ba bjalo ka mesong.

tokens.gloss: go tšwa go sefelle se segolo
